'''Palace Security''' was the [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|security]] detail of the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]] under the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] government. It was led by [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Jak Bremen]].

==History==
In [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], several [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] agents entered the Palace attempting to [[Raid on Coruscant (Thrawn Crisis)|kidnap]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] and her children [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina]] and [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]]. The agents dressed in Palace Security uniforms, however, they were discovered by [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] who alerted [[General/Legends|General]] [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]] and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]. General Iblis alerted Palace Security and firefight ensued during which all the agents were killed except their leader, [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Molo Himron]]. During interrogation, Himron fingered Mara Jade as the person who had let them into the Palace. Colonel Bremen had Jade placed under house arrest. She was later freed and absolved. Additionally, Colonel Bremen and his second, [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Machel Kendy]] were attempting to discover the mysterious [[Delta Source]] that had been able to breach Palace Security and transmit secret information to [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]]. With help from Leia Organa Solo, [[Winter Celchu|Winter]], and a [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] named [[Zakarisz Ghent]], Palace Security was able to stop Delta Source which was [[Ch'hala tree]]s growing in the [[Grand Corridor]] of the Imperial Palace.
